description: This file contains functions and logic for detecting CUDA kernel launches in PyTorch code, specifically checking for kernel launches without proper error checks. It includes regex patterns, file traversal, and analysis functions related to CUDA kernel launch safety.

methods.name: find_matching_paren
methods.description: Finds the index after the matching closing parenthesis, accounting for nested parentheses.

methods.name: should_exclude_file
methods.description: Determines if a filename should be excluded based on suffixes in exclude_files.

methods.name: check_code_for_cuda_kernel_launches
methods.description: Analyzes code to count CUDA kernel launches without proper error checks.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks a specific file for unsafe CUDA kernel launches, considering file extension and exclusions.

methods.name: check_cuda_kernel_launches
methods.description: Traverses the PyTorch codebase to count all unsafe CUDA kernel launches across files.
